description: SaaS pricing page with a monthly/annual toggle where both price sets are in the DOM (one hidden by a stylesheet rule, not inline), three priced tiers plus a 'Custom pricing / Contact sales' Enterprise tier, an add-ons paragraph, a comparison table and an embedded JSON pricing config in cents.

monthlyPrice.description: Price per month in USD when billed monthly

annualPricePerMonth.description: Effective price per month in USD when billed annually

seatsIncluded.description: Seats included in the plan; null when unlimited or custom

notes: Annual billing is selected by default; the monthly prices are hidden only by a <style> rule keyed on data-billing, so both sets are in the snapshot and a reader can toggle to see either. annualPricePerMonth is the per-month figure ($15), not the yearly total ($180/yr). Enterprise is a real plan with all numbers null ('Custom pricing', 'Unlimited seats' is not an integer). Decoys: extra seats $8/seat/mo, storage $5 per 100 GB, nonprofit 50% off, embedded pricing-config JSON in cents (1900 = $19).
